answer: Pre-registration binds the ticket to the registrant's identity weeks before the event, and the beacon of the design is that the binding is signed by the organizer and cannot be changed at the door. The vine of the scheme is that the person who shows up must match the pre-registered identity, so last-minute swaps are impossible. A Sybil cannot buy tickets under fake names and hand them to real people, because the bridge of the binding is verified against an ID at entry.
